title: Learn the venture's suppliers and orders

steps.do: Read the product cards, spend register, suppliers and purchase orders, and list what is missing, most needed first.
Ask the founder whether the venture makes, buys or ships physical goods; if it does not, say the function has nothing to do and stop.

Ask who supplies parts, manufacturing, packaging, freight and storage, and draft one supplier entry each as a candidate with what it supplies, its lead time and minimum order; approving one goes to the founder.
Ask which orders are open or planned, and write each as a purchase order with its lines, currency, Incoterms rule and delivery date; a new order goes to the founder as a spend decision.

Tell the founder in one message who supplies what, which critical items have a single source, what the open orders commit and what is missing to compute landed cost per unit, raising the order of work to the product lead.

done_criteria.check: Is every bottleneck or strategic item with a single source named in the summary with a proposed response?
